title: Painting the Garden Bench
story: Mateo and his aunt decided to paint the old garden bench. They carried sandpaper, brushes, and a tin of green paint outside. First they rubbed the wood until it felt smooth. Mateo covered the grass with newspaper so drops would not fall there. His aunt showed him how to move the brush in one direction. They painted the legs and then the seat. A sudden breeze blew a leaf onto the wet paint. They lifted it off and smoothed the mark. Before lunch they finished the top and left the bench to dry. After lunch they painted the back and the arms. The colour looked bright against the grey wall. They washed the brushes in a bucket and closed the tin. Mateo wrote the date on a label and stuck it under the seat. The next day the bench was dry, and they sat there with tea.
